rows.q: A UK customer's trainers split open after 80 days. The drop window is 7 days. Do we help?
rows.answer:
Yes, we can help if the issue is caused by a covered manufacturing defect [1]. 

While the 7-day drop window applies to returns [2, 4], defects such as sole separation or broken stitching are covered under the Repairs and Defects policy (provided it is not normal wear, fading, or machine-washing damage) [1]. Covered repairs are handled free of shipping costs at the Rotterdam workshop (taking 10 to 15 business days), and a replacement or refund is provided if a repair is not possible [6].
